arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && for f in fib_max fib_mix; do
  /usr/bin/time -v /work/submit/planb64 build $f.txt $f.idx 2> tm.txt; rc=$?
  echo "$f build rc=$rc time=$(grep 'Elapsed' tm.txt | tr -s ' ') mem=$(grep 'Maximum resident' tm.txt | tr -s ' ') rows=$(sed -n 2p $f.idx)"
done
head -3 fib_max.idx; tail -2 fib_max.idx; wc -l fib_max.idx fib_mix.idx
